text:
incidents-bot: PAGER — inference-pool-usw2: 90% of pods reporting OOMKilled / kubelet restarts in last 2m. Severity: P1. Pager: Priya N. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2078901234
Priya N: on it, joining call now. seeing spike in 5xx and tail latency for hostnames in usw2. paging Sam and Kelsey.
Sam T: I’m awake, looking at cluster. noticed 3 nodes flapping NotReady -> Ready loop, kubelet restart reasons show repeated `kubelet: out-of-memory` logs.
Kelsey R: joining — can you paste pod list for inference pool? I want to confirm which model shards are hitting OOM.
Sam T: sure — running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=usw2 -o wide`
Sam T: ```
NAME                                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-ggml-0                           0/1     CrashLoop 5          2m
inference-gpt-q-5-abc                      0/1     OOMKilled 3          6m
inference-encoder-rc-1                     1/1     Running   0          10m
...```
Diego: logs from the crashing pod show CUDA OOMs and then kubelet killed container: `Runtime.OOMKilled` followed by node kernel OOM killer messages. Looks like these nodes ran out of allocatable memory for GPU processes.
Kelsey R: Are these nodes autoscaled GPU instances or reserved?
Priya N: this is Dedicated/GPU reserved pool for inference-usw2 (dedicated). We have limited buffer. Burst workers are not enabled here.
Sam T: immediate plan: 1) cordon the most unstable node(s) 2) drain non-critical pods 3) scale up dedicated pool with extra nodes (if cloud API allows fast provisioning) 4) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for high-priority customers to reduce memory footprint.
Priya N: Agreed. Kelsey, can you cordon node `gpu-usw2-12` and drain non-critical pods? I'll open a scale request with infra.
Kelsey R: doing `kubectl cordon gpu-usw2-12 && kubectl drain gpu-usw2-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — patching in progress.
Kelsey R: drain command output: `Pod inference-ggml-0 evicted`, `Pod inference-gpt-q-5-abc terminated`. Draining now.
support-ops: FYI support flagged 2 customers: AcmeMedia and Travelly reporting elevated latency/errors via support tickets. They are ondedicated-usw2.
Priya N: Sam, can you apply emergency routing policy to move traffic for AcmeMedia to fallback pool in us-east? Use traffic-policy `reroute:fallback-lowmem` for their customer id.
Sam T: doing. Posting command I ran: `redwoodctl routes update --customer AcmeMedia --policy reroute:fallback-lowmem --region us-east`
Sam T: routing update applied, canary at 5% then 50% then 100% after verifying no regressions.
Diego: infra response: cloud autoscaler reports quota available, provisioning 2 new p4-like nodes (estimated 4m). Kube shows `Node gpu-usw2-17 provisioning` then `Registered`.
Sam T: meanwhile we should reduce memory footprint for model replicas still serving. Suggest quick deploy: switch heavy variant `gpt-large-v2` -> `gpt-large-q4_0` quantized variant across pool. Priya, can you approve a fast rollback/quant deploy?
Priya N: approve. Do the rollout as a canary 10% then 100%. Add `--max-unavailable=1` to the deployment to avoid mass restarts.
Kelsey R: rolling update command: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-gpt-large inference=gpt-large-q4_0:latest -n inference` then monitoring logs.
Sam T: logs show fewer OOMs after first canary. CrashLoop count dropping. Node `gpu-usw2-12` remains NotReady but drained. New nodes are coming up.
Diego: node health: `kubectl get nodes` snippet: ```
gpu-usw2-12   NotReady   3d   kubelet restarted
gpu-usw2-17   Ready      10s  registered
gpu-usw2-18   Ready      20s  registered
```
Priya N: Customer impact summary so far: ~3% of production traffic in us-west-2 experienced 5xx spikes for ~6m before reroute. Critical customers AcmeMedia and Travelly were affected but reroute succeeded for AcmeMedia fully, Travelly is 80% shifted. Ops: support-ops is coordinating with Travelly PM.
support-ops: Travelly wants a postmortem and ETA on when nodes will be stable. We told them ~15-20m for full capacity back.
Kelsey R: I’m seeing kernel messages that suggest oom_adj churn from a misbehaving sidecar on a few nodes. We should add a pod-level memory request guardrail to prevent sidecars from starving model containers. Filing quick follow-up ticket.
Sam T: Handing off on-call to Kelsey — Priya stepping off in 10m. Kelsey you have the incident lead.
Priya N: Handoff note: cluster stabilized, two new nodes added, model quant rollout reduced memory usage, core inference services are healthy. Will remain reachable if needed. Handoff ETA 10m.
Kelsey R: taking over. My immediate next steps: keep monitoring OOM count, ensure drained node `gpu-usw2-12` is reprovisioned or rebuilt, file postmortem and mitigation plan (guardrails + auto-fallback to lowmem variant when memory pressure > 70%).
Diego: quick dump of kubelet log on gpu-usw2-12: ```
Mar 25 03:22:45 kubelet[1234]: eviction manager: attempting to reclaim memory
Mar 25 03:22:45 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 9876 (python) score 500
Mar 25 03:22:46 kubelet[1234]: container runtime status: OOMKilled
Mar 25 03:22:47 kubelet[1234]: Kubelet restarted due to oom-respawn loop
```
Kelsey R: marking incident as mitigated in the incident tracker, severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem and guardrail work. Creating ticket: https://redwood.issues/INC-5472
Priya N: quick note for postmortem: confirm whether sidecar resource limits were applied consistently across Dedicated pools, check autoscaler thresholds for dedicated reservations, and add runbook step to immediate-enable fallback routing.
support-ops: customers notified: AcmeMedia acknowledged fix, Travelly notified of partial failover and SLA credit request open.
Kelsey R: no new OOMs in last 7m, 95th latency back to normal. I’ll keep monitoring for 1 hour then close this thread. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident 2078901234 state changed to MITIGATED by Kelsey R. Postmortem ticket INC-5472 created.
Priya N: thanks all, great run.
Sam T: nice coordination.
Diego: filing small follow-ups: add node-level memory pressure alerts earlier and automated fallback enable trigger.
Kelsey R: end of thread — will update postmortem link here when available.
